acts.palette: cream, oxidized brass, slate blue, charcoal, enamel green, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of an imagined mechanical counting hall, read bottom to top. At the bottom, crossed blue and amber paper light beams meet at a closed door; farther up, oak filing drawers, a pendulum bridge, black relay boxes and green test benches line the sides. Cream punched cards and black keys lead toward an elevated circular gear platform at the top, clearly reserved for the Era Processor. Keep a broad, quiet cream middle ground open for path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background in a mechanical signal hall: muted cream tiled floor, distant brass lamps casting crossed blue and amber shapes, shallow silhouettes of clocks and filing drawers along the edges. A few small teal hexagonal paper tiles cling to a far corner. Keep the center open and quiet for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background deeper in the same counting hall: subdued black relay banks, copper-coloured leads, linked gears and a pendulum walkway recede along the sides of a pale floor. Teal hexagonal growth spreads in connected patches along the lower walls and between machines. Keep the center open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background near the processor: muted stacks of blank cream punched cards, black keys and green circuit boards form a distant mechanical corridor. Dense overlapping teal hexagonal growth climbs the walls and creeps across the floor edges, partially swallowing gears and card stacks. Leave a calm open center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Era Processor, centered on a circular platform: a rolling tower with a broad wheel base, stacked clay tablet slabs, rows of oversized black keys, fanned blank cream punched cards and green circuit boards, all joined by exposed brass gears. Its stepped tower silhouette narrows upward and its gear joints project clearly on either side; leave space around the whole figure. Teal hexagonal growth grips the lower armor. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.

acts.palette: archive beige, slate gray, disk black, muted blue, copper, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of an imagined electronic collection, read bottom to top. Begin at the bottom with an open beige disk drive and scattered black disks; climb past a segmented green toy at a steel doorway, a silver disc player, repair benches and rows of shelves holding blank-screen computers. Near the top, shelves curl inward around a clearly defined open boss chamber for the Living Collection. Keep a broad pale middle ground clear for path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background in an electronic archive: muted beige shelves with dark blank monitors, disk drives and a few scattered black disks flank a pale open floor. A handful of teal hexagonal paper tiles appear behind a shelf foot. Keep the center clear for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background farther into the archive: subdued rows of storage cabinets, silver discs, coiled copper wires and a repair bench line the edges, with shelves beginning to angle inward. Connected teal hexagonal patches spread across shelf backs and floor margins, binding a few disks in place. Keep the center clear for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background at the collection's heart: muted banks of blank monitors and hinged shelves close around the distant edges, with disks and loose paper held still beneath dense teal hexagonal growth. Overlapping hexagons cover much of the walls and creep across the floor margins. Leave a quiet pale central area for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Living Collection, centered with its entire broad silhouette visible: a squat towering stack of beige computer cases and dark blank monitors, disk-drive shoulders and long hinged steel shelf arms spread outward like closing gates. Give it a stable cabinet base and visible brass pin joints; blank disks nest in its shelves while teal hexagonal growth binds parts of the stack. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.

acts.palette: chalk white, sensor blue, charcoal, ochre, warm gray, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical top-down papercraft diorama of an imagined robotics workshop and test range, read bottom to top. At the bottom, a blue camera casts long cut-paper shadows across a white test floor; continue past lane markings without symbols, orange paired arms over a gap, a rope and clamp bench, and a rocky rover ramp with round beacons. At the top, a clearly defined circular test chamber with radiating arm tracks awaits the Integrated System. Keep the middle ground broad and pale for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide, low-contrast fight background in a robotics test range: pale white and warm gray floor, distant blue camera stands casting long soft-edged paper shadows, muted lane strips and small rover ramps at the sides. A few teal hexagonal tiles cling to a remote floor seam. Keep the center open for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background in a robot workshop: subdued orange articulated arms, a rope-and-clamp bench, gray test blocks and white sensor panels sit along the edges. Teal hexagonal growth spreads in connected sheets over wall joints and around equipment bases. Keep a pale open center for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.

Wide, low-contrast fight background inside the integrated test chamber: muted blue sensor towers and folded white arm tracks frame the edges, with dense teal hexagonal growth covering much of the wall and encroaching on the floor. A few cables disappear beneath overlapping hexagons. Preserve a quiet pale central area for small creatures. Layered grainy construction paper, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints, soft shadow-theatre light; no central subject, logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Large imposing full-body Integrated System, centered with the entire machine visible: a tall blue sensor tower with a prominent round camera rises from a wide black wheeled base. Multiple long white articulated arms sweep outward in a symmetrical branching silhouette, and a ring of small camera drones floats around the upper tower. Show a distinct cable running from the tower to one gripper and teal hexagonal growth around the base. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat colour, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting; no logos or readable text.
